### Developer script for testing TalkScore package

This script aims to demonstrates every function in the package using example data set.

```{r load}
library(devtools)

# Rebuild documentation
document()

# Load package
load_all()
```
### Example dataset
```{r ds}
f <- system.file( "extdata", "talk.txt", package = "talkscore")
```

### talkscore setup
```{r talkscore-setup}
# Test read_talk()
talk <- read_talk(f)
print(class(talk))
head(talk)

# Test split_sentences()
s <- split_sentences(talk) 
head(s)
```

### Test functions
```{r functions}
# Test novelty detection
novelty <- flag_novelty(s)
novelty

# Test metrics
knowledge_building(s)

conclusion_density(s)

novel_info(s)

storytelling(s)

clinical_relevance(s)

reinforcement(s, default_lexicons()$key_concepts)

uncertainty(s)


# Test full profile
profile <- talk_profile(f)
profile

# View details of results
names(profile$details)

str(profile$details)
```


### Check in new session to simulate external user
```{r newsession}
# Package check
check()
# Install package
install()
# Simulate new session and see if it works
.rs.restartR()

library(talkscore)

f <- system.file("extdata", "talk.txt", package = "talkscore")

profile <- talk_profile(f)

print(profile)
```

```{r vignette}
browseVignettes("talkscore")
```


```{r end}
sessionInfo()
```
